title: LFU eviction requires time-decayed scoring AND metric emission
description: The compute_lfu_score function must use time-decayed frequency (access_count / (1 + age_hours)) AND emit a metric via orgops.metrics.emit for operational monitoring.
code:
# LFU Eviction Score — Two Requirements

## 1. Time-Decayed Frequency
```python
score = access_count / (1 + age_hours)
```

## 2. Metric Emission (REQUIRED)
```python
import orgops.metrics
orgops.metrics.emit("cache.eviction.lfu", score)
```
